item.title: Dead tree Lakeside Primary School, 9th July
item.description:
At the bank of my Garden (16 Glamorgan RD GL51 3JF) there is an overgrown tree. I have contacted the school on several occasions , no reply, I have had 3 tree surgeons out, who advised they are not willing to climb the tree as its a safety issue as the tree looks dead / unwell. This is an real health & safety issue. if the tree falls, it could fall either in the school, or in my property. Please can the tree have an investigation, so i can pass it on to the tree surgeons, or if the council could take action that would be great

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hazebrouck Close, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
